items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 11 June 2026 4:13am
items.description:
##Today##

Wet start to the day with persistent rain or drizzle for much of the morning. Rain largely clearing early afternoon and remaining cloudy, but an ongoing risk of a few showery outbreaks of rain at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

7-15


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S 20-25, soon veering SW 15-20, veering W or SW 15-20 occasionally 25 in the evening, backing SW 10-15 overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain or drizzle, then becoming good occasionally moderate in the afternoon. Hill fog soon becoming isolated.


##Comments##

Strong winds at times.


##Tomorrow##

Mainly dry with variable and at times large amounts of cloud, but also some bright or sunny spells.

##Comments##
